description: This is a test class for the QuickLaunchDao, which is part of the Dashboard module's Data Access Object layer in the OrangeHRM system. The file contains unit tests that verify the behavior of the QuickLaunchDao methods related to fetching quick launch menu items based on different configurations and modules enabled.

classes.name: QuickLaunchDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the QuickLaunchDao class in various scenarios related to fetching quick launch menu items based on plugin configuration and module states.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, instantiating the QuickLaunchDao object and setting up mock services and configuration for each test.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchList1
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the quick launch list when modules are enabled and periods are defined, expecting a specific set of menu items.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchListForESS1
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the quick launch list for ES system under similar configuration, expecting a filtered subset of menu items.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchList2
methods.description: Tests retrieval when modules are enabled but periods are undefined, expecting an empty list.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchListForESS2
methods.description: Tests for ESS with modules enabled but periods undefined, expecting an empty list.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchList3
methods.description: Tests scenario where the leave module is disabled, expecting only time-related menu items.

methods.name: testGetQuickLaunchListForESS3
methods.description: Similarly tests for ESS with leave module disabled, expecting only time-related menu items.
